evals.prompt: Design an immersive homepage journey that keeps recruiter clarity within 30 seconds.
assertions: Output explicitly defines a recruiter fast path with CV/contact access.
Output includes an exploration path that does not hide critical content.
Output defines at least 3 key transitions and why each exists.
Output specifies reduced-motion alternate behavior for each key transition.
Output includes a handoff mapping to implementation owner skills.

evals.prompt: Create a reveal strategy for station discovery without forced delays.
assertions: No reveal requires waiting to access text or CTAs.
Triggers include keyboard and touch equivalents for hover-only interactions.
Anti-patterns include motion-gated content and forced scrolling.
